body:
- **Tailwind utilities first.** Every shell component in `apps/chrome-ext/` and every viewer package should default to Tailwind classes on JSX. Raw CSS classes (`.fv-*`) are reserved for *rendered content* where an external library (react-markdown, react-json-view) owns the DOM and Tailwind utilities can't be injected inline. MDX body typography is the only accepted `fv-*` in `apps/chrome-ext/src/styles/index.css`.
- **Package-local styles stay in the package.** If a viewer package (`packages/json-viewer`, `packages/mdx-viewer`, future) needs styles, use Tailwind utilities on its JSX or a co-located `.css` the package imports. Do **not** hoist per-package CSS into `apps/chrome-ext/src/styles/index.css`. The host stylesheet only carries app-wide tokens + MDX body typography.
- **shadcn tokens are the palette.** Always style with `bg-muted`, `text-foreground`, `border`, `text-destructive`, etc. Never write `bg-gray-900` or `#0f1115` inline — those break theme switching.
- **Dark mode via `@custom-variant dark (&:is([data-theme="dark"], …))`.** shadcn's `.dark` selector maps to our `[data-theme="dark"]` attribute. Don't add a `.dark` class manually anywhere.
